_README: Hypotheses the explained-difference regression gate (decision P22, scripts/identity_regression_gate.py, phase Q2h) checks against the rows it computes at the cutover.
kind: filing_lineage (added or removed accessions) or market_tape (changed FTD / short-volume rows). reason: the gate rule that must explain every row of the hypothesis.
status stays `hypothesis` until the gate produces the matching accessions or rows; `expected` is the measured count, `source` where it was measured.

table (filing_lineage, default fundamentals_history_sec) and tape_source (market_tape: ftd, finra or <source>_ticker_grain) narrow the counted rows; dates lists ticker-grain rows a hypothesis explains by name (reason other_issuer_line).

Q2h (dry run against the live snapshot): market_tape counts are re-measured against the stored live tables, which the pre-branch tenure resolver built; section 2.2 measured them against the q1-lineage resolver, which attributed fewer rows (see each note).
